description: This Java class handles the command to delete a savings account charge in the Fineract application. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, is annotated as a Service, and is associated with the command type for deleting savings account charges.

classes.name: DeleteSavingsAccountChargeCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class responsible for handling delete commands for savings account charges in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Executes the delete operation for a savings account charge using the write platform service based on the provided command.
